ignoreCommand: if printf '%s' "${VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE:-}" | grep -q '\[skip vercel\]'; then exit 0; fi; if [ -n "${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-}" ] && git cat-file -e "${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then git diff --quiet "${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA}" HEAD -- app.py pyproject.toml vercel.json .vercelignore && exit 0 || exit 1; fi; exit 1
